# LSP 3.17 meta-model

`metaModel.json` is the machine-readable meta-model of the *Language Server Protocol Specification - 3.17*, which
check K2 validates server messages against.

- **Title:** Language Server Protocol Specification - 3.17, meta-model (`metaModel.json`, version 3.17.0)
- **Source:** <https://github.com/microsoft/language-server-protocol/blob/f20ba0702f2bbfe538226a5255739fc118744407/_specifications/lsp/3.17/metaModel/metaModel.json>
  (branch `gh-pages`, commit `f20ba0702f2bbfe538226a5255739fc118744407`)

  unlike the rest of lspcheck, which is Apache-2.0
- **Changes:** none. The file is the original, byte for byte: 395 147 bytes, SHA-256
  `c207890d9e0f54d8f9e462a924670f563423ec9af90a0a369645ff55384c8d6d` (a unit test checks the digest).
  `.gitattributes` keeps Git from changing its line endings.
